assumptions.feeRate: 0.03 before 10 July 2026 and 0.05 afterward, category assumptions not contract-level verification

assumptions.baseline: first reconstructed two-sided book midpoints normalized only if their sum exceeds 1; all become available at the latest initial midpoint time. The aligned model baseline starts at the same time.
assumptions.dynamicFairValue: The observed current book midpoint is blended with the prior-day model score at each quote decision; individual blended values need not sum to one.
assumptions.marketData: midnight boundary books excluded; prior feed continuity, exchange sequencing and queue positions are not attested; market eligibility uses the full day and is a retrospective complete-case filter, not an ex-ante tradable rule
assumptions.forecast: prior calendar days only; retrospective model and historical input revisions lack vintage proof
assumptions.target: Sharpe annualization is illustrative only, not evidence of a robust strategy
